column3: “They remained three years” is rendered “three years passed.”
Close to the Hebrew; NASB supplies “I am.”
The Hebrew reads “Lord” (Adonai), as NASB does.
“Clothed garments” is rendered “arrayed in their robes.”
“The spirit” is rendered “a spirit,” and “deceive” as “entice.”
“A spirit of falsehood” is rendered “a deceiving spirit.”
“Spirit of falsehood” is rendered “deceiving spirit,” and “spoken evil” as “proclaimed disaster.”
“Where did it pass” is rendered “How did … pass.”
“A room in a room” is rendered “an inner room.”
“Official of the city” is rendered “governor of the city.”
“Bread of oppression and water of oppression” is rendered “feed him sparingly with bread and water.”
“O peoples, all of them” is rendered “all you people.”
“Wear your clothes” is rendered “put on your robes.”
